description: This file defines a mock class `AbstractDocumentifierMock` used for unit testing within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the `AbstractDocumentifier` class and provides a `documentify` method that converts a `SugarBean` object into a document-friendly array, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: AbstractDocumentifierMock
classes.description: A mock subclass of `AbstractDocumentifier` used in unit tests, providing an implementation of the `documentify` method.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a `SugarBean` object into an array suitable for document indexing by calling the parent class method.
